text:
ela-sales: Quick ask — RetailCo wants a 4-day POC: migrate their streaming endpoint to our SDK with structured JSON + a single fraud tool call. Minimal code changes please.
nate-se: We can do a shim wrapper to avoid touching business logic. Two operational risks: backpressure on long-lived connections and needing warm KV caches for session continuity.
zoe-ml: For structured output ask for their JSON schema and ~20 gold examples. We'll run a pytest suite that fails the build if any case deviates.
cal-devex: Security: provide ephemeral keys (TTL 1h) and HMAC webhooks for tool callbacks. For demo we should stub the fraud API in our sandbox.
ela-sales: They asked about costs if we pre-warm nodes. Can we run hosted demo without a Dedicated commit?
cal-devex: Yes. Hosted with pre-warm via synthetic replay is fine for a short POC. We'll estimate tokens once they send sample traffic.
nate-se: Action: send 50 sample requests. Quick rough calc: avg 70 tokens/request -> 50 rps => ~210k tokens/min. Factor ~1.15 for function call overhead.
zoe-ml: Also recommend a short fan-out phase (mirror requests to both systems) to measure parity and warm caches. Use idempotency keys to dedupe.
ela-sales: Customer needs audit logs + key revocation. Can we push logs to their SIEM?
cal-devex: Yes, we can stream audit logs to an S3 bucket or webhook. We'll include revocation steps and a rotation script in the runbook.
infra-bot: POC ticket created: POC-7777. Demo cluster target: 2025-05-20T09:00:00Z.
ela-sales: Next steps: I'll collect samples and schedule a 30m sync. Nate -> shim + dedupe doc; Zoe -> pytest harness + acceptance tests; Cal -> rotation + stub. Keep runbook short.
cal-devex: Will upload artifacts to shared drive by EOD tomorrow and include cURL and SDK examples.
nate-se: Quick non-SDK cURL example for function-call streaming:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" -d '{"stream":true,"model":"redwood-small","functions":[{"name":"fraud_check","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}}}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
But recommend SDK for reconnects and on_function_call callbacks.
ela-sales: Thanks team. I'll ping customer and update. :thumbsup:
